news.hook: MIT researchers reveal how smart harness designs turn language models into compositional powerhouses, tackling tasks far beyond their training data.
news.name: MIT Paper Shows Language Model Harnesses Boost Generalization
news.summary: A new MIT CSAIL paper by Alex L. Zhang, Souradip Chakraborty, and Omar Khattab argues that well-designed harnesses enable models to compose capabilities for stronger generalization on long or new tasks. By keeping prompts locally in-distribution through abstractions like context offloading and recursive sub-agent calls, these harnesses avoid errors from growing context windows in standard agents. Experiments on benchmarks like OOLONG and OBLiQ-Bench demonstrate models generalizing to tasks 8–64× longer, with gains like a 27B-parameter model improving 27% on long-context suites using fewer tokens. Co-authors stress that harness design and model learning are deeply intertwined, countering views that stronger models will make them obsolete.

news.summary: Traveling from North Carolina to meet a new niece, Piquette's family faced immediate hassle when airline staff said they cover loss but not damage to the stroller. His TikTok video of the ordeal drew 2.9 million views, leading to a call from Southwest's executive office where the representative defended the limited liability policy on strollers and offered just a $200 voucher. Southwest later told USA TODAY they provided $500 reimbursement too, but Piquette vows never to fly with them again amid widespread frustration over family travel policies.

news.summary: Malaysia's Immigration Department announced on November 17 that the 30-day visa exemption for Indian nationals, started in December 2023 to aid tourism recovery, will end December 31, 2026. All Indian passport holders must apply for visas via the MyVISA portal from December 1, 2026, with non-refundable fees and a required Malaysia Digital Arrival Card. The change follows increased Indian visitors and warnings about agents misleading people with fake job offers, as Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail seeks better pre-arrival checks. Public views differ, with some seeing it as necessary due to abuse and others as a disappointment for Indian travelers.

news.summary: The Kenya Airports Authority's draft order sets fees from Sh25 at smaller airports to Sh250 per completed trip at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for taxis and ride-hailing services like Uber and Bolt, separate from higher parking rates and annual permits up to Sh250,000.
